types.description: A session is blocked waiting for the operator's decision or input.
A PR gate (test, review, UX or sweep) is red or cannot proceed.
A pull request passed its gates and was merged.
A build or CI run failed.
A release moved to the next environment stage.
A change request is waiting for the operator's approval.
A fleet machine stopped reporting past the offline threshold.
A previously offline fleet machine is reporting again.
A UPS accessory switched to battery power.
A UPS accessory is back on mains power.
A CI runner guest VM is low on free disk space and will soon fail jobs.
The tap-writer lock is held past its stale threshold, or the watcher cannot read it.
A stale or unreadable tap-writer lock condition has cleared.
No CI pool machine can take a queued job class, so CI is stalled. Paged once per incident.
The CI dispatcher cannot do part of its job (GitHub unreachable or runner minting failing).
A fork pull-request job asked for a pool runner and was refused.
A pool job has ambiguous or invalid runner labels and cannot be placed.
CI jobs have waited past the queue-age threshold on a label set. Paged once per incident.
A CI no-capacity or queue-age incident has cleared (one notice per incident).
